ruling.author: velvetmonkey
ruling.scope: Ben ruled on 2026-09-06 at 11:07, in his words: "do it". PR 236 ships the pin-history ledger that PROVENANCE.txt already promises. RE-RECORDED at 11:34 after the branch was brought up to date with main. Main protection sets strict=true, so a branch must be current before it can merge, and updating the branch MOVED the merge-base from c69f62f8 to 858d2cd9, which correctly invalidated the previous record. A ruling binds the merge-base by design, so it cannot outlive a rebase. TWO protected artifacts appear and they are NOT equal in kind. FIRST, wasm-spike/verified/pin-history.json is the real change Ben approved: a 55-line ledger recording each assurance-kit commit with its kernel sha256 and its status. SECOND, test/fixtures/readme-demo-checker-output.txt is a TOUCH AND REVERT with ZERO net change; I re-read its blob AFTER the update and it is still 91368ba4838472067d3d80ec2f74cef4d196bbd5 on both origin/main and this head, so the two remain byte-identical. It must appear here because the checker requires the recorded file set to equal the reported set exactly. I verified the new merge-base and both blob digests on disk before writing.
retires: The 2026-09-06 11:31 record on this same branch, base c69f62f8, superseded when the branch was brought up to date with main and the merge-base moved to 858d2cd9.
